entities.name: Damian Brown
entities.role: Strategic Mage | Battlefield Controller | Calm Executioner
entities.description: A calculated, calm, and disciplined high-tier arcane specialist trained by Eldrich Aldercrest.
entities.quote: Damian calculates. PHASE 1 — PRIMARY ABILITIES (Before Eldrich) (White-picture tier: innate magical alignment) Damian is naturally compatible with magic, even before learning it.

entities.name: Eldrich Aldercrest
entities.description: Catalyst mentor who teaches Damian structure, restraint, and consequence.
entities.quote: Liam / Eldrich Aldercrest doesn’t just teach Damian spells. He teaches him structure, restraint, and consequence.

entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: A character who explodes when pushed, contrasting with Damian's calculated nature.
entities.quote: Zayn explodes when pushed. Damian calculates.

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: Mentioned in relation to a comparison of discipline versus demonic will.
entities.quote: Damian vs Khalid (discipline vs demonic will)
